quest.title: Shrine Cleanup
quest.description: Neko, "Provisional Head Priestess of the Asase Shrine," seems to be troubled about something...

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: The shrine is getting messy again...

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Meow, it is you again. Well met.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Ah, the fallen leaves infest the shrine once again. How unsightly...

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: This is no way to greet those humans coming to pay their respects.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Could you aid me in cleaning up the shrine, as you did before?

choices.text: Don't you have Taisuke and Etsuko around?

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: I... will not speak to those two green humans of my own accord.

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: The tall human always looks upon me with a strange gaze...

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: And the other green human never seems particularly... motivated?

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: Meow meow, regardless, they are not reliable humans.

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: Whatever the case, I can only rely on you for this task. Just use the long stick to clean it all up.

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: Whatever the case, I shall leave this to you. I...

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: I will wait for you here, meow meow.

choices.text: I got you, more or less.
Well, you could ask Mr. Ooshima...

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: The stone human is always busy with his knock-knock-knocking. Who knows what he is doing.

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: The stone was knocked, after all. What is he knocking this time, I wonder... How annoying...

talks.objective: Sweep the fallen leaves around the Asase Shrine away

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: In any case, the cleanup shall be left to you. I will wait for you here, meow meow.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Mm, have you finished this "cleanup" business?

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Meow meow, that is good. You are indeed very reliable.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: The shrine certainly looks the part now. Ah, Hibiki will be pleased when she returns.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: I must continue taking good care of this shrine... Meow meow...
